notes.title: CAPTURED: INSANITY UPDATE v1.2.1.0
notes.content:
Hello anomaly hunters!
To celebrate the announcement of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3390880/CAPTURED_2]CAPTURED 2[/url], CAPTURED is getting a new content update. It includes a new game mode, a new entity, a leaderboard and more, so let's dive right in!

[h1]INSANITY GAME MODE[/h1]

I was looking into more creative ways to make anomaly games more challenging that did not involve harder to find anomalies. The Insanity game mode spins the genre on its head, adding a unique roguelike twist to your anomaly hunting experience.

You can capture anomalies infinitely, and every 3 loops you are offered deals with special perks and advantages, each coming with a drawback. These deals are randomly generated, making each run unique and exciting.

Your max sanity starts the same as in Hard difficulty, but each time you complete a loop it gets increasingly smaller.

Use your luck wisely and make the right decisions to increase your stats and dominate the loops.

[h2]ANOMALY LEADERBOARD[/h2]

You can now compete for first place for the most captured anomalies!
Along with the new Insanity game mode comes a leaderboard which tracks the most anomalies captured in a single run.

All your Safe Mode, Normal, Hard and Nightmare runs qualify, but the Insanity mode will allow you to achieve scores way beyond the limits of the other modes.

[h2]NEW ENTITY – DR. SPIDER[/h2]

Another possessed toy from Jason's childhood joins the loops!
Dr. Spider can only be encountered in higher difficulties (Hard, Nightmare and Insanity mode).

[h3]EASY DOORS [/h3]

Since you are not equipped with any weapons, doors in CAPTURED are a very important mechanic that players have to master in order to survive against some of the loop's entities.

However, some players have expressed how they found the door physics mechanic hard to use and that it took away from their experience.
If you are struggling with doors, you can now enable EASY DOORS in the GAMEPLAY SETTINGS tab.

This new difficulty option allows players to open and close doors with a single interaction key.

[h3]DEFORMED ROOMS SANITY[/h3]

While CAPTURED embraces exploration, it can be very hard to do so with low sanity.
Now, when you enter large deformed rooms, your sanity will stop decreasing, allowing you to explore and look for the missing dolls.

Small deformed rooms that do not contain dolls will continue to drain your sanity.

[h3]FIXES[/h3]

[list]
[*] General UI fixes and improvements
[*] Fixed text overlapping itself in wider resolutions
[*] Fixed red light bleed on the window blinds from a hallway lighting anomaly
[*] Fixed a Virtual Shadow Maps issue causing shadows to flicker for some players in rooms with multiple light sources
[/list]


Thank you everyone for sharing your love for CAPTURED and your beautiful feedback.
This is my very first game and it means the world to me that I am able to turn it into a series.
I can't wait to share more about CAPTURED 2, so if you haven't already, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3390880/CAPTURED_2]Wishlist it on Steam[/url].

Thank you,

Puck

notes.title: CAPTURED Winter Seasonal Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

For a limited time, some anomalies are getting a festive makeover! Winter has covered some rooms with snow, ice, gifts, and holiday decorations.

I’m incredibly grateful for all the love and support you’ve shown for CAPTURED. It truly means the world to me, and I hope this update brings a little extra magic to your experience.

I’m excited to share in early 2025 what I’ve been working on, but until then, I wish you a warm and wonderful holiday season! 🎁❄️

- Puck

notes.title: CAPTURED 1.0.12 - Small Patch
notes.content:
- Progress Tracking
You can now track your captured anomalies! You can view how many unique anomalies you've captured when selecting a difficulty. Please note: anomalies captured before this update will not be included, as tracking wasn't available prior to version 1.0.12. This feature is purely informational and not tied to any achievements.

- Tutorial Tips
Small adjustments have been made to the tutorial to better explain the "ANOM" counter and indicate where to find the Motion Sickness Accessibility settings.

notes.title: CAPTURED Halloween Seasonal Update
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

For a limited time, some anomalies are getting a spooky makeover for the Halloween season! Take a peaceful walk through the forest anomaly and keep an eye out for a special Halloween item.

Thank you all for your love and support for CAPTURED. Wishing you a spooky and Happy Halloween!
[b]
NEW LIMITED ITEM[/b]

[i]A new pumpkin item is waiting to be found in the Forest anomaly. It can protect you against Hornhead![/i]

[b]SPOOKY DECORATIONS[/b]

[i]Some anomalies have been updated with skeletons, pumpkins, and Halloween decorations.[/i]

notes.title: CAPTURED 1.0.9 - Small Patch
notes.content:
[b]- Camera Tilt Option[/b]
[i]You can now turn off camera tilting in Gameplay Settings.[/i]

[b]- Mr. Blue Collision Fix[/b]
[i]Improved Mr. Blue's collision box, which was previously allowing him to catch players through the door if they were standing against it.[/i]

notes.title: CAPTURED 1.0.4 - New Features and Fixes
notes.content:
[h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2]

[b]- Second Chance Deal
[/b][i]If you miss or incorrectly select an anomaly while only 1 anomaly away from reaching the required amount to escape, the Demon offer you a second chance deal. [/i]

[b]- Key Remapping
[/b][i]You can now customize your keybinds in the CONTROLS tab in the settings.[/i]

[h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2]

[i]- Players will no longer be able to trap themselves behind the chair during the toilet murder scene anomaly.

- Cabinets in the Laundry Room will no longer open during the Kitchen Poltergeist anomaly.

- Updated the Demon’s voice line near the end of the game to avoid confusing players.[/i]

[h2][b]Balancing[/b][/h2]

[i]- The demon will warn you upon entering the dead zone in the hospital.

- Once you've captured the required number of anomalies, you'll receive a notification instructing you to leave the loop to escape.[/i]

notes.title: CAPTURED 1.0.1 - Small Balance Patch
notes.content:
- [b]Anomaly Type Information[/b]
[i]You can now view information for each anomaly type by hovering over its button in the anomaly type selection menu.[/i]

- [b]Demon Nerf[/b]
[i]The demon will no longer eliminate you immediately, allowing more time to escape.[/i]
